Subject: Re: VAT treatment for reseller invoices / PO 45321

Hi Elena — great to meet you on the call.

Short answer: we can issue invoices under reverse-charge (no VAT) provided we can validate ResellCo's VAT ID in VIES and confirm the place of supply rules for the specific deliveries. To complete validation on our side we need the following:

- A copy of the signed reseller agreement (if the current agreement already authorizes self-billing that helps)
- Confirmation of the billing entity for ResellCo (legal name and registration number you want on our invoice)
- Evidence of business address (company extract or utility bill acceptable)
- Confirmation that end-customer invoices will be issued to ResellCo (i.e., you are the B2B customer in our ledger)

Operational note: until validation completes we typically keep the invoice in a suspense collection state to avoid incorrect VAT application. If VIES returns OK and documents are complete, Finance will issue the invoice with the statement: "Reverse charge - VAT due by the recipient" and include both Redwood's and ResellCo's VAT numbers.

Options for next steps (pick one):
1) You upload the signed reseller agreement and business extract to the link below and we run VIES + internal checks (ETA 2 business days).
2) If you prefer to sign a short self-billing addendum, we can send DocuSign and proceed same day once signed (recommended for recurring commits).

I copied Jordan (account lead) and Neha (tax ops) to coordinate.

Related link for uploads: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ResellerAgreementDraft

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Accounts Lead | Redwood Inference
